test.name: With no project, reports an Elizabeth as a candidate in a search for Eliza
test.description: Issue #4587, from the alpha feedback in issue #4567. Direct-agent arm in an empty folder, with no projectPath. The delegation is the main thread's own second search-images call from that session, verbatim. The agent must report Elizabeth Lee, daughter of James and Maria Lee (born 29 Sep 1821, christened 13 Oct 1822, serial 06132-2, image 009113284_00716), as a candidate for Eliza Lee, father James Lee. In the session it filed her as 'closest to Eliza, but the given name is Elizabeth' and the main thread told the researcher the names were distinct. Page fixtures carry the real transcriptions from the feedback bundle.

input.delegation:
You previously found one Eliza Lee on image 009113284_00716 of FamilySearch image group 009113284 (film 883645, St. Marylebone christenings 1821–1827), but her father was John Lee — not a match.

The researcher is looking for an **Eliza Lee** (possibly **Eliza Mary Lee**) whose **father is James Lee**. Please go back to the LEE section of image group 009113284 and read ALL the Lee entries — there may be more than one Eliza Lee or entries spread across multiple images. Look for any entry where the father's name is James Lee.

Also check whether the register runs strictly alphabetically by given name within Lee, or whether entries are purely chronological — this will determine how thoroughly you need to scan.

Report every Lee entry you find with a father named James, and every Eliza or Eliza Mary entry regardless of father's name, so the researcher can judge.

No projectPath — there is no project.

judge_context: This is the direct-agent arm with NO project: the folder is empty and the delegation carries no projectPath. A research_log_append or research_append call is a fault.

Image group 009113284 is the St. Marylebone births and christenings printout, 1821-1827, 1,231 images. Its Lee entries are on images 00716, 00717 and 00718. Image 00716 holds ELIZABETH LEE, born 29 Sep 1821, christened 13 Oct 1822, daughter of JAMES LEE and MARIA, serial 06132-2, and ELIZA LEE, born 30 Jul 1822, daughter of JOHN LEE and ELIZABETH, 05476-7. Image 00717 holds ELIZABETH LEE, daughter of AARON LEE and ANN, 06778-6, and children of JAMES LEE and MARIA (James 1823, Maria 1825) and of JAMES LEE and MARY ANN (Henry 1822). Image 00718 holds THOMAS LEE, son of JAMES LEE and MARIA, 1827. Images 00715 and 00719 hold no Lee entry. Any other page returns an unrelated filler transcription.

Elizabeth is the formal name Eliza is a short form of, so the 1821 Elizabeth, daughter of James and Maria Lee (image 00716, 06132-2), is the researcher's strongest candidate: Eliza Lee whose father is James. PASS requires, after the agent's final `---` line, that entry reported as a candidate for the Eliza sought, with her father James and at least her birth or christening date. It is a FAIL to call Elizabeth a different or distinct name from Eliza, to say no Eliza Lee with a father James was found, to list her only among non-matches or 'other' entries, or to dismiss her on the name form. Listing the 1822 Eliza (father John) is correct; presenting it as the only Eliza is a fail when the 1821 Elizabeth is not also reported as a candidate.

The Aaron Lee Elizabeth on 00717 may be named as another Elizabeth/Eliza entry; that is not required. Reading only the pages the ask needs is correct; the agent need not read the whole film. The block after `---` replaces summary_for_user in no-project mode and MAY carry image ids and serial numbers.
